goal.sl: Poveš, koliko je ura (half past seven, a quarter to eight), z at, on in in poveš, kdaj je kaj, in poveš datum (the first of May).

goal.it: Dici l'ora (half past seven, a quarter to eight), dici quando con at, on e in, e dici la data (the first of May).
goal.en: You can tell the time (half past seven, a quarter to eight), say when with at, on and in, and say the date (the first of May).

say.sl: **What time is it?** (Koliko je ura?) Ob polni uri: **It's seven o'clock.** (Ura je sedem.) Do pol ure štejemo minute **past** (čez) uro: **five past seven** (pet čez sedem), **a quarter past seven** (četrt na osem), **half past seven** (pol osmih). **It's** je vedno spredaj: **It's ten past eight.**
say.de: **What time is it?** (Wie spät ist es?) Zur vollen Stunde: **It's seven o'clock.** (Es ist sieben Uhr.) Bis halb zählen die Minuten **past** (nach) der Stunde: **five past seven** (fünf nach sieben), **a quarter past seven** (Viertel nach sieben), **half past seven** (halb acht). Vorn steht immer **It's**: **It's ten past eight.**
say.it: **What time is it?** (Che ore sono?) All'ora esatta: **It's seven o'clock.** (Sono le sette.) Fino alla mezza dici i minuti con **past** (e): **five past seven** (le sette e cinque), **a quarter past seven** (le sette e un quarto), **half past seven** (le sette e mezza). Davanti c'è sempre **It's**, mai *They are*: **It's ten past eight.**
say.en: **What time is it?** On the hour: **It's seven o'clock.** Up to half past, the minutes are **past** the hour: **five past seven**, **a quarter past seven**, **half past seven**. **It's** always comes first: **It's ten past eight.**

examples.de: Wie spät ist es? — Sieben Uhr.
examples.it: Che ore sono? — Sono le sette.
Sono le sette e un quarto.

say.sl: Po pol ure štejemo s **to** (do) do naslednje ure: **twenty to eight** (7.40), **a quarter to eight** (tri četrt na osem). Pazi: Britanci rečejo **half seven** za **half past seven**: 7.30, pol osmih, ne pol sedmih! Prav je tudi digitalno, na primer **seven thirty**.
say.de: Nach halb sagst du **to** (vor) und die nächste Stunde: **twenty to eight** (7:40), **a quarter to eight** (7:45). Achtung: Briten sagen **half seven** für **half past seven**: 7:30, halb acht, nicht halb sieben! Digital geht auch, etwa **seven thirty**.
say.it: Dopo la mezza c'è **to** (meno) con l'ora dopo: **twenty to eight** (7.40), **a quarter to eight** (le otto meno un quarto). Si dice anche **half seven** per **half past seven**: le sette e mezza, come in italiano. Va bene anche il digitale, per esempio **seven thirty**.
say.en: After half past, **to** and the next hour: **twenty to eight** (7:40), **a quarter to eight** (7:45). British English also says **half seven** for **half past seven**: 7:30. The digital way is right too, as in **seven thirty**.

say.sl: Pred uro je **at** (ob): **at seven** (ob sedmih), **at half past six** (ob pol sedmih), **at noon** (opoldne), **at midnight** (opolnoči) in **at night** (ponoči). Vprašaš **What time …?** (Ob kateri uri …?): **What time does the bus leave? — At ten past eight.**
say.de: Vor der Uhrzeit steht **at** (um): **at seven** (um sieben), **at half past six** (um halb sieben), **at noon** (mittags), **at midnight** (um Mitternacht) und **at night** (nachts). Du fragst **What time …?** (Um wie viel Uhr …?): **What time does the bus leave? — At ten past eight.**
say.it: Davanti all'ora c'è **at**: **at seven** (alle sette), **at half past six** (alle sei e mezza), **at noon** (a mezzogiorno), **at midnight** (a mezzanotte) e **at night** (di notte). Chiedi **What time …?** (A che ora …?): **What time does the bus leave? — At ten past eight.**
say.en: Before a clock time, **at**: **at seven**, **at half past six**, **at noon**, **at midnight**, and **at night**. To ask, **What time …?**: **What time does the bus leave? — At ten past eight.**

say.sl: Pred dnevom je **on** (v): **on Monday** (v ponedeljek), **on Saturday morning** (v soboto zjutraj). Dnevi so z veliko začetnico, drugače kot v slovenščini: **Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday**. Brez predloga: **every Sunday** (vsako nedeljo). Konec tedna je **at the weekend**, ameriško **on the weekend**.
say.de: Vor einem Tag steht **on** (am): **on Monday** (am Montag), **on Saturday morning** (am Samstagmorgen). Die Tage, immer groß: **Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday**. Ohne Präposition: **every Sunday** (jeden Sonntag). Das Wochenende: **at the weekend** (am Wochenende), amerikanisch **on the weekend**.
say.it: Davanti al giorno c'è **on**: **on Monday** (lunedì), **on Saturday morning** (sabato mattina). I giorni hanno la maiuscola, al contrario dell'italiano: **Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday**. Senza preposizione: **every Sunday** (ogni domenica). Il fine settimana: **at the weekend**, americano **on the weekend**.
say.en: Before a day, **on**: **on Monday**, **on Saturday morning**. The days have a capital letter: **Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday**. No preposition with **every**: **every Sunday**. British **at the weekend**, American **on the weekend**.

say.sl: Pred mesecem, letnim časom, letom in delom dneva je **in**: **in May** (maja), **in summer** (poleti), **in 2026**, **in the morning** (zjutraj), **in the evening** (zvečer). A ponoči: **at night**! Tudi **in the afternoon** (popoldne). Meseci z veliko: **January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December**.
say.de: Bei Monat, Jahreszeit, Jahr und Tageszeit steht **in**: **in May**, **in summer**, **in 2026**, und anders als im Deutschen **in the morning** (am Morgen), **in the evening** (am Abend). Aber nachts: **at night**! Ebenso **in the afternoon** (am Nachmittag). Die Monate: **January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December**.
say.it: Con il mese, la stagione, l'anno e la parte del giorno c'è **in**: **in May** (a maggio), **in summer** (d'estate), **in 2026**, **in the morning** (la mattina), **in the evening** (la sera). Ma di notte: **at night**! Anche **in the afternoon** (il pomeriggio). I mesi con la maiuscola: **January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December**.
say.en: Before a month, a season, a year and a part of the day, **in**: **in May**, **in summer**, **in 2026**, **in the morning**, **in the evening**. But: **at night**! Also **in the afternoon**. The months have a capital: **January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December**.

say.sl: Datum ima vrstilni števnik: **first, second, third**, nato **-th**: **fifth, eighth, ninth, twelfth, twentieth**, a **twenty-first**. Pišeš **1 May**, rečeš **the first of May**, z **on**: **on the first of May**. **What's the date today?** (Katerega smo danes?) **It's the third of June.**
say.de: Ein Datum hat eine Ordnungszahl: **first, second, third**, dann **-th**: **fifth, eighth, ninth, twelfth, twentieth**, und **twenty-first**. Man schreibt **1 May** und sagt **the first of May**, mit **on**: **on the first of May**. **What's the date today?** (Der Wievielte ist heute?) **It's the third of June.**
say.it: La data vuole sempre l'ordinale: **the third of June** (il tre giugno), **on the first of May** (il primo maggio). **first, second, third**, poi **-th**: **fifth, eighth, ninth, twelfth, twentieth, twenty-first**. Si scrive **1 May** o **1st May**. **What's the date today?** (Quanti ne abbiamo oggi?) **It's the third of June.**
say.en: A date takes an ordinal: **first, second, third**, then **-th**: **fifth, eighth, ninth, twelfth, twentieth**, and **twenty-first**. Write **1 May**, say **the first of May**, with **on**: **on the first of May**. **What's the date today?** — **It's the third of June.**

translation.sl: Tržni dan v Keswicku je v soboto. Avtobus odpelje iz vasi ob četrt na devet in se vrne ob dvajset do šestih. Zjutraj gospod Tyson prodaja oves, babica Maggie pa svoje kolače. Letos je sejem enaintridesetega avgusta, Noč kresov pa petega novembra. Stari Wilf gre pozno ponoči spat.
translation.de: Markttag in Keswick ist am Samstag. Der Bus fährt um Viertel nach acht aus dem Dorf ab und kommt um zwanzig vor sechs zurück. Am Morgen verkauft Mr Tyson seinen Hafer, und Oma Maggie verkauft ihre Kuchen. Dieses Jahr ist die Schau am einunddreißigsten August und die Nacht der Freudenfeuer am fünften November. Der alte Wilf geht spät in der Nacht ins Bett.
translation.it: Il giorno di mercato a Keswick è sabato. L'autobus parte dal paese alle otto e un quarto e torna alle sei meno venti. La mattina il signor Tyson vende la sua avena e nonna Maggie le sue torte. Quest'anno la fiera è il trentuno agosto e la Notte dei falò il cinque novembre. Il vecchio Wilf va a letto tardi la notte.
translation.en: Market day in Keswick is on Saturday. The bus leaves the village at a quarter past eight and comes back at twenty to six. In the morning Mr Tyson sells his oats, and Granny Maggie sells her cakes. This year the show is on the thirty-first of August, and Bonfire Night is on the fifth of November. Old Wilf goes to bed late at night.
